steps.title: Cream the shortening
steps.body: Cream together **¾ cup shortening** and **1 cup sugar**.

steps.title: Add the egg and molasses
steps.body: Add and mix in **1 egg** and **¼ cup molasses**.

steps.title: Mix in the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix in **2 cups flour**, **1 Tbsp ginger**, **2 tsp baking soda**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **¼ tsp ground cloves** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Roll and coat
steps.body: Roll in 1-inch balls and coat with coarse sugar (regular sugar will work but your family will know you didn’t plan ahead).
